free_tier.stated: Budget line 'Pico' at EUR 25.00/year: 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe SSD, 1 TB bandwidth, sold in Poland and the USA (the tracker names Gdansk and New Jersey). The Budget 'Nano' is EUR 3.00/month with 1 GB and 15 GB, and the Pro line's 'Pico' is EUR 30.00/year with the same 512 MB and 10 GB. The tracker's EUR 2.08/month row is this EUR 25.00 annual plan divided by twelve.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month is the stated allowance on this plan; the card states no overage price and no throttle, so the post-allowance behaviour is unverified

chaining: EUR 25.00 a year for 512 MB in Poland or New Jersey is a standing host for a webhook receiver, a certificate checker or an uptime monitor, where 1 TB is ample and the annual prepay is the only real cost; it is not a host for anything that moves bytes
